not_run: Live ConPort writes (decision/progress): out of scope; only receipt shape + approval-phrase gate implemented.
Live dope-memory mirror writes: out of scope; only mirror-receipt shape implemented.

residual_risks: task-orchestrator must never become the memory authority; the routing wrapper is the only safe shape — a future packet adding a non-routed write would violate authority boundaries.
ConPort schema/port drift (5455 vs alternative) is not covered; receipt shape assumes the canonical schema.
Audit trail relies on receipts being mirrored to dope-memory; if mirror routinely fails, the chronicle becomes unreliable.

Revert CLI wiring for `orchestrator memory record_decision` / `record_progress` previews in src/dopemux/commands/orchestrator_commands.py.
commit_sha_policy: A committed proof file cannot self-reference the commit SHA that contains its final contents. The authoritative local commit SHA is reported by git after commit creation and in the session closeout.
